HandsOn provides 18,000 curated simulated dexterous-manipulation demonstrations
in LeRobot v2.1 format. Each episode contains measured robot states, commanded
actions, language instructions, and synchronized RGB from three cameras.
The data supports training and offline analysis for the HandsOn benchmark.
